jobDescription:

Financial Reporting & Analysis Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for RNAIPL in compliance with Ind AS/IFRS. Conduct provision controlling and variance analysis to support business decisions Handle accounting for design & development costs and product introduction cost in accordance with applicable standards. Monitoring Inventory accounting and relevant controls for necessary bookkeeping and book closure. Supervise account reconciliations to ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data. Maintain lean balance sheet with periodical reviews and refinement Lead Group reporting package in line with Renault Groupe requirements.
